item.title: Firing near Venezuela Presidential Palace, drone shot down; Details inside
item.description: Gunfire erupted near Venezuela’s presidential palace in Caracas after a suspected drone was spotted flying over the area, prompting authorities to activate the air defence system. Security forces shot down the drone using anti-aircraft weapons and sealed the area with armoured vehicles.

item.title: Unrest escalates in Iran; At least 35 Killed, 1200 detained
item.description: The situation has become so dire that the public has now taken to the streets against the Islamic regime. Challenging the authority of the government led by Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, protests have been ongoing for several weeks in many major cities across the country.

item.title: The MTA Speaks: Maduro case raises questions over power, law, and sovereignty; In-depth analysis here
item.description: The detention of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro by the US military has sent shockwaves across global politics. The incident has raised serious questions about international law, national sovereignty, and the balance between power and justice. Read an exclusive analysis by veteran journalist Manoj Tibrewal Aakash.

item.title: Another Hindu killed in Bangladesh; Death toll reaches 6 in 18 days
item.description: On Monday night, Sharat Chakraborty Mani, a 40-year-old Hindu grocery store owner, was killed in Narsingdi district. On the same day, Hindu journalist Rana Pratap Bairagi was murdered in Manirampur, Jashore.

item.title: Sensex opens lower despite positive global cues; Nifty slips below
item.description: Indian stock markets opened lower on January 6, 2026, with the Sensex falling over 100 points and the Nifty slipping below 26,200 despite positive global cues. Early trade saw selling pressure in key stocks, while broader markets remained mixed.

item.title: Ram Rahim granted release for 405th day under parole and furlough rules
item.description: It is an encouragement for the prisoner's good behavior in jail. The period spent by the prisoner outside jail on furlough is counted towards their sentence.

item.title: Magh Mela 2026: Spectacular ‘Mahamagh’ after 75 years; Devotees flock for holy dip
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 began on January 3 in Prayagraj with over 3.5 million devotees taking a holy dip at the Sangam. Held after 75 years as a rare Mahamagh Mela, the 44-day religious fair features grand spiritual rituals, advanced security, modern facilities, and major bathing festivals.

item.title: Delhi Fire Tragedy: Three family members burnt alive in Adarsh Nagar; Full details
item.description: A devastating fire broke out in DMRC staff quarters in Adarsh Nagar, Delhi, in the early hours of January 6, claiming the lives of a family of three-Ajay Vimal, his wife Neelam, and their 10-year-old daughter Jahnvi.

item.title: Odisha Horror: Four students get burns while playing with fire at Rayagada school; Details here
item.description: According to reports a classmate allegedly threw some thinner on the floor and set it ablaze at the Upgraded High School in Paik Dakuluguda on Monday.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi admitted to Sir Ganga Ram Hospital; Here’s her health update
item.description: Senior Congress leader Sonia Gandhi was admitted to Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in Delhi on Tuesday. Her condition is stable, and she is under the supervision of a chest specialist. The admission is routine, as Sonia Gandhi regularly undergoes health check-ups due to her chronic cough and the city’s rising pollution levels.
